```python
# Test cases for csv_rows(text)

# Basic functionality
assert csv_rows("a,b,c") == [["a", "b", "c"]], (csv_rows("a,b,c"), [["a", "b", "c"]])
assert csv_rows("a\nb") == [["a"], ["b"]], (csv_rows("a\nb"), [["a"], ["b"]])

# Quoted fields containing commas
assert csv_rows('a,"b,c",d') == [["a", "b,c", "d"]], (csv_rows('a,"b,c",d'), [["a", "b,c", "d"]])

# Quoted fields containing newlines
assert csv_rows('a,"b\nc",d') == [["a", "b\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('a,"b\nc",d'), [["a", "b\nc", "d"]])

# Doubled quotes as escaped quotes
assert csv_rows('a,"b""c",d') == [["a", 'b"c', "d"]], (csv_rows('a,"b""c",d'), [["a", 'b"c', "d"]])

# CRLF line endings
assert csv_rows("a,b\r\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\r\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]])

# LF line endings
assert csv_rows("a,b\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]])

# Empty fields and trailing commas
assert csv_rows(",,") == [["", "", ""]], (csv_rows(",,"), [["", "", ""]])
assert csv_rows("a,") == [["a", ""]], (csv_rows("a,"), [["a", ""]])

# Complex mixed case
complex_input = '1,"Field with , comma",3\n"Field with\nnewline",5\n"Double ""quote"" test",6'
expected_output = [
    ["1", "Field with , comma", "3"],
    ["Field with\nnewline", "5"],
    ["Double \"quote\" test", "6"]
]
assert csv_rows(complex_input) == expected_output, (csv_rows(complex_input), expected_output)

# Empty string
assert csv_rows("") == [], (csv_rows(""), [])

# String ending with newline (should not create extra empty row)
assert csv_rows("a,b\n") == [["a", "b"]], (csv_rows("a,b\n"), [["a", "b"]])

# String ending without newline
assert csv_rows("a,b") == [["a", "b"]], (csv_rows("a,b"), [["a", "b"]])
```
